csv_scope_of_work: Marin County Transit District ( Marin Transit or The District ) intends to engage the services of an engineering/consulting firm herein referred to as General Engineering Consultant ( GEC or Consultant ) to provide On-Call General Engineering Services ( GES ). The selected team must possess the planning, evaluating, cost estimating, architectural and design engineering, investigatory, negotiating, socio-environmental, advisory, and operational expertise required to plan, design, develop, implement, operate, and maintain large and small transportation projects. The primary project areas for GES are: Bus Stop Improvements (siting, operations, amenities, ADA accessibility) Bus Transfer Location Improvements Owner s Representative for Facility Design General Engineering Support Construction Management.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: General Engineering Services - Marin County
short_description: On-call engineering services for Marin Transit transportation facilities and bus stop improvements.
project_scope: On-call general engineering services for Marin County Transit District covering large and small transportation projects. Primary areas include bus stop improvements with siting, operations, amenities, and ADA accessibility; bus transfer location improvements; owner's representative services for facility design; general engineering support; and construction management. Total stated construction cost is 2.0 million USD.
services: On-call general engineering consulting services including planning, evaluation, cost estimating, architectural services, design engineering, investigatory services, negotiation, socio-environmental advisory, operational support, and maintenance-related support. Requested disciplines: architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, cost estimating, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call general engineering services without a clearly defined single structure.
- Focus is mainly bus stops, transfer locations, facility support, and general transportation consulting.
- Includes structural engineering, but this is only one of many disciplines.
- Strong emphasis on planning, advisory, and construction management rather than distinctive structural design.
- Project type does not match sbp's core priorities such as bridges, long-span roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice states an on-call contract with a 36-month base period and 24-month renewal option, but no consultant fee, budget split, or engineering fee percentage is stated.
contracting_authority: Marin County Transit District, San Anselmo, CA, USA. Contact: Javier Peraza. Phone: 415-226-0870. Fax: 415-507-2648. Email: jperaza@marintransit.gov. Website: https://marintransit.bonfirehub.com/opportunities/242778
notes: On-call RFP/RFQ for general engineering services. Pre-submittal meeting: 07/31/2026 05:00 PM PDT, virtual, attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 07/21/2026 05:00 PM PDT. Contract duration is renewable with 36-month base period and 24-month renewal option. Although structural engineering is listed, the procurement is broad multidisciplinary support rather than a defined building or bridge project.
